warnings.message: Portability review: backend-adapter surfaces detected (audio legacy helpers, gui, ui, worlds, shader). These APIs are useful, but they still need stable Storie-level contracts before they should be treated as backend-neutral compile semantics. The new audio.asset/audio.analysis/audio.play handle layer is the preferred migration target for portable audio work.
JS-only runtime access detected (audio.context, audio raw node constructors, getParam). Portable or Nim-target compilation should reject, isolate, or replace these browser-specific APIs.
